mods.name: Dark Sanctuary (Wii U port)
mods.author: TheBestestJoe
mods.description: This is a port of Dark Sanctuary, a Mario Kart DS custom track by elHongo14 based on Deltarune chapter 4. This is based on my previous switch port of the track with some changes to account for the lack of BCP materials and objects. Some elements of this port, such as coin placement, were inspired by the Mario Kart 7 port by Necrozma.

mods.name: Mario Kart ALL STARS (warning memes)
mods.author: i don't want to list all of them
mods.description:
little silly modpack with some silly characters

I made this modpack for my personal use, and though it would be fun to upload it.

I haven't made most of the mods used in the modpack, if you want to credit someone, credit the mods creators instead.

I don't exactly remember what mods I have put in it, so if you see your mod in my modpack, please contact me so I can add your name in the credits (my username is mukfall on Discord).

I made two versions of the modpack : one with custom tracks (wich I don't recommend playing in multiplayer, it's very laggy) and one with vanilla tracks.

The Sonic character is an invisible character. To play with Sonic, pick the Sonic character then pick the horse-thing kart, and the blue wheels wich are also invisible.

Some characters do not have custom ui.

The "Vanilla Tracks" version of this modpack is online safe, though the "Custom Tracks" version is not.

Custom tracks list :

Waterpark : Coconut mall
Cake : Green Hill Zone
Peach circuit : A track from Sonic R
Wario Stadium : Diamond city
SNES Rainbow road : Another track from Sonic R
Wii U Rainbow road : Cyber Road
Toad Harbor : Delfino Isle
